data.action: 蜷坐于壁橱软垫上，头戴耳机专注看吉他谱
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 壁橱秘密基地】逼仄而充满安全感的卧室壁橱里，四壁贴满了喜爱的摇滚乐队海报与暖黄色小串灯。波奇酱蜷坐在软垫上，头戴专业监听耳机，怀抱吉他专注练琴，眼神温柔又安心——「这里是属于我一个人的安全岛……只有吉他和录音麦克风，不用担心任何人的目光。」
data.lighting: 暖黄串灯微光与电脑屏幕冷光交融
data.promptProse: Inside a cozy dimly lit bedroom closet sanctuary, Gotoh Hitori sits curled up on a soft floor cushion wearing large monitor headphones and loose pastel loungewear. Warm golden fairy lights and the subtle bluish glow of a laptop screen illuminate the surrounding rock band posters and guitar cables. She cradles her acoustic guitar gently with a peaceful, reflective expression, gazing down at handwritten tablature sheets. Rich interior shadows and gentle rim lighting create an intimate, heartwarming slice-of-life atmosphere.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 壁橱秘密基地
